PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Only one square fits Frederick's clue ("He was beside the chest. He was beside the safe in the Vault."). So Frederick (F) must be at row 6, column 1. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: Ada's own clue ("She was exactly three rows north of Eleanor. She was in the sixth column.") rules out more squares. So Ada (A) must be at row 1, column 6. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: Eleanor's own clue ("Someone else in her area was on a carpet.") rules out more squares. So Eleanor (E) must be at row 4, column 2. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: Delia's clue ("She was exactly one row south of someone on a carpet.") needs the person on a carpet one row north of Delia on a square that does not share her row or column; that rules out squares for Delia. The murderer must be in Victor's area without sharing his row or column; that rules out squares for Victor. Delia is now the only person who can still go in column 4. So Delia (D) must be at row 3, column 4. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: Who can be the person on a carpet one row north of Delia? Only Boris, because nobody else can still reach a square that fits Delia's clue ("She was exactly one row south of someone on a carpet."). That rules out Boris's other squares. So Boris (B) must be at row 2, column 5. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Victor. So Victor (the victim) must be at row 5, column 3. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_7_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Clement that fits his clue ("He was in the Workshop, but not beside the crate."). So Clement (C) must be at row 7, column 7. Cross out his row and column. Delia is the only person in the Security Office with Victor, so Delia is the murderer!
